Thanks for the context, team. Quick legal ops notes from my side:

1) POA acceptability
- We can accept a POA for the UK signer provided it is dated, signed by an authorized officer of the signing entity, and references the MSA/Order Form. A notarized or apostilled POA is preferred for cross-border certainty but not strictly required — acceptable alternatives are a corporate board resolution or certified officer letter.

2) DocuSign routing recommendation (high-level)
- Routing lane A (parallel): US signer (CFO) + UK signer (authorized signatory, with POA attached).
- Routing lane B (post-completion): Olive Escrow (post-only recipient), Vantage ops (post-only), Redwood Legal (evidence copy).
- Envelope settings: Require certificate of completion; enforce ID check for UK signer if POA is scanned rather than notarized. Add a required attachment field for the POA.

3) Evidence & retention
- We will produce a stamped clean copy (PDF) with DocuSign certificate. Redwood Legal will retain the audit trail and clean copy per our 7-year retention policy (we'll provide the short written confirmation to Vantage after execution).

Please attach the signer lists (legal names + emails) and any POA draft. I'll attach a routing template you can reuse for other deals. If notarization is required by your compliance team we need to escalate to Redwood Legal for a notarization exception (timing note: notarization will add 2–5 business days).
